name: select
title: Select
description: Accessible dropdown selector built on ui-sdk, with groups, labels, separators and scroll buttons.
docs: Bind Select with v-model and v-model:open when needed. Every SelectItem must receive a non-empty value string because empty strings clear the selection and show the placeholder. Set invalid on SelectTrigger for validation errors.

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ChangeDetails } from '@ui-sdk/core'
import {
  Select as SelectRoot,
  type SelectOpenChangeReason,
  type SelectValueChangeReason,
} from '@ui-sdk/vue/select'
import { provide } from 'vue'
import { selectItems } from './selection'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SelectProps = {
  /** Initial value when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  name?: string
  required?: boolean
  autocomplete?: string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectProps>(), {
  defaultValue: undefined,
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  disabled: false,
  name: undefined,
  required: false,
  autocomplete: undefined,
})

const model = defineModel<string>()
const open = defineModel<boolean | undefined>('open', { default: undefined })
const items = new Map<string, (event: Event) => void>()
const selections = new WeakMap<Event, boolean>()
provide(selectItems, items)

function emitSelection(value: string, originalEvent: Event | undefined) {
  const event = new CustomEvent('select.select', {
    bubbles: true,
    cancelable: true,
    detail: { originalEvent, value },
  })
  items.get(value)?.(event)
  return event.defaultPrevented
}

function onValueChange(value: string | null, details: ChangeDetails<SelectValueChangeReason>) {
  if (value === null || details.reason !== 'item-press') return
  const canceled = emitSelection(value, details.event)
  if (details.event) selections.set(details.event, canceled)
  if (canceled) details.cancel()
}

function onOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<SelectOpenChangeReason>) {
  if (next || details.reason !== 'item-press') return
  const event = details.event
  const current = model.value ?? props.defaultValue
  const canceled =
    (event && selections.get(event)) ?? (current !== undefined && emitSelection(current, event))
  if (event) selections.delete(event)
  if (canceled) details.cancel()
}
</script>

<template>
  <SelectRoot
    v-model:open="open"
    :multiple="false"
    :value="model === '' ? null : model"
    :default-value="defaultValue || undefined"
    :default-open="defaultOpen"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :name="name"
    :required="required"
    :auto-complete="autocomplete"
    v-bind="$attrs"
    @value-change="onValueChange"
    @open-change="onOpenChange"
    @update:value="model = $event ?? ''"
  >
    <slot />
  </SelectRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectValue as SdkSelectValue } from '@ui-sdk/vue/select'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SelectValueProps = {
  placeholder?: string
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SelectValueProps>(), {
  placeholder: undefined,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkSelectValue
    v-if="$slots.default"
    v-slot="{ state }"
    :placeholder="placeholder"
    v-bind="$attrs"
  >
    <slot :model-value="state.value ?? undefined" :selected-label="state.labels" />
  </SdkSelectValue>
  <SdkSelectValue v-else :placeholder="placeholder" v-bind="$attrs" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs, useTemplateRef, type ComponentPublicInstance } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SelectContent as SdkSelectContent, SelectList } from '@ui-sdk/vue/select'
import SelectScrollButton from './SelectScrollButton.vue'
import { useSelectScroll } from './scroll'
import { selectSurface } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SelectContentProps = {
  position?: 'popper' | 'item-aligned'
  side?: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'
  sideOffset?: number
  align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectContentProps>(), {
  position: 'popper',
  side: 'bottom',
  sideOffset: 6,
  align: 'start',
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
const list = useTemplateRef<ComponentPublicInstance>('list')
const listElement = computed<HTMLElement | null>(() => {
  const node = list.value?.$el
  return typeof HTMLElement !== 'undefined' && node instanceof HTMLElement ? node : null
})
const { canScrollUp, canScrollDown, scroll } = useSelectScroll(listElement)
</script>

<template>
  <SdkSelectContent
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :align-item-with-trigger="props.position === 'item-aligned'"
    :side="props.side"
    :side-offset="props.sideOffset"
    :align="props.align"
    :class="
      cn(
        selectSurface,
        props.position === 'popper' && 'min-w-[max(8rem,var(--anchor-width,0px))]',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <SelectScrollButton v-if="canScrollUp" direction="up" @scroll="scroll(-1)" />
    <SelectList ref="list" class="min-h-0 overflow-y-auto p-1.5">
      <slot />
    </SelectList>
    <SelectScrollButton v-if="canScrollDown" direction="down" @scroll="scroll(1)" />
  </SdkSelectContent>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectGroup as SdkSelectGroup } from '@ui-sdk/vue/select'
import { provide } from 'vue'
import { selectGroup } from './selection'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

provide(selectGroup, true)
</script>

<template>
  <SdkSelectGroup v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </SdkSelectGroup>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SelectGroupLabel as SdkSelectGroupLabel } from '@ui-sdk/vue/select'
import { selectGroup } from './selection'
import { selectLabel } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const grouped = inject(selectGroup, false)
const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="grouped ? SdkSelectGroupLabel : 'div'"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(selectLabel, attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SelectSeparator as SdkSelectSeparator } from '@ui-sdk/vue/select'
import { selectSeparator } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkSelectSeparator v-bind="forwarded" :class="cn(selectSeparator, attrs.class as ClassValue)" />
</template>

export const selectSurface = [
  'z-50 flex max-h-[min(20rem,var(--available-height,20rem))] min-w-[8rem] flex-col gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0 rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised text-ink shadow-popup outline-none',
  'origin-[var(--transform-origin)]',
  'data-[side=bottom]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:-4px]',
  'data-[side=top]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:4px]',
  'data-[side=left]:[--p0seid0n-pop-x:4px] data-[side=left]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:0px]',
  'data-[side=right]:[--p0seid0n-pop-x:-4px] data-[side=right]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:0px]',
  'motion-safe:animate-pop-in data-ending-style:motion-safe:animate-pop-out',
].join(' ')

export const selectItem = [
  'relative flex h-9 cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] px-3',
  'text-[14px] font-medium text-ink-muted outline-none',
  'transition-[background-color,color] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-fast)] ease-out-expo motion-reduce:transition-none',
  'hover:bg-control hover:text-ink',
  'focus:bg-control focus:text-ink',
  'data-[highlighted]:bg-control data-[highlighted]:text-ink',
  'data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-55',
].join(' ')

export const selectLabel = 'px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-medium text-ink-faint'

export const selectSeparator = 'my-1 h-px bg-line'

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onScopeDispose } from 'vue'

defineProps<{ direction: 'up' | 'down' }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{ scroll: [] }>()

let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined

function stop() {
  clearInterval(timer)
  timer = undefined
}

function start(event: PointerEvent) {
  if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse' || timer !== undefined) return
  timer = setInterval(() => emit('scroll'), 80)
}

onScopeDispose(stop)
</script>

<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    tabindex="-1"
    :aria-label="direction === 'up' ? 'Scroll up' : 'Scroll down'"
    class="flex shrink-0 cursor-default items-center justify-center py-1 text-ink-muted"
    @pointerenter="start"
    @pointerleave="stop"
    @pointerdown.prevent
    @click="emit('scroll')"
  >
    <svg
      :class="direction === 'up' ? 'size-3.5 rotate-180' : 'size-3.5'"
      viewBox="0 0 16 16"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="1.75"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4" />
    </svg>
  </button>
</template>

export { default as Select } from './Select.vue'
export { default as SelectTrigger } from './SelectTrigger.vue'
export { default as SelectValue } from './SelectValue.vue'
export { default as SelectContent } from './SelectContent.vue'
export { default as SelectGroup } from './SelectGroup.vue'
export { default as SelectItem } from './SelectItem.vue'
export { default as SelectLabel } from './SelectLabel.vue'
export { default as SelectSeparator } from './SelectSeparator.vue'

export type { SelectProps } from './Select.vue'
export type { SelectTriggerProps } from './SelectTrigger.vue'
export type { SelectValueProps } from './SelectValue.vue'
export type { SelectContentProps } from './SelectContent.vue'
export type { SelectItemProps } from './SelectItem.vue'
